Contracts.Title: A quiet route home to {dest}
Contracts.Brief: Mara has discharged this patient. Escort them safely to {dest}; no enemy wave is commissioned. Return them to a normal life, not another fight.
Contracts.Name: Discharged canal worker

Contracts.Title: A civic signal beneath {place}
Contracts.Brief: The receiver log marks a tear at {place}. Close the mite breach and file the signal through this board. The receiver will carry a quieter band.

Contracts.Title: Condensers for {dest}
Contracts.Brief: Collect the sealed condenser satchel from Dante. Carry it to {dest}, then use the delivery crate to sign for it. Jax needs these parts to keep the bays running.
